evals.expected_output: A production-grade Seedance 2.0 on Higgsfield prompt for a 360-degree turntable showcase of the watch, around 15-25 lines, opening with a 2-second hook and including labeled camera, rotation, lighting, and timeline sections plus a macro detail beat for the back engraving.
expectations: Output is a Seedance 2.0 (Higgsfield) video prompt describing a full 360-degree rotation or turntable spin of the watch, not a static photo or a generic ad script
Includes a distinct opening hook of roughly 2 seconds (e.g. spotlight snap or light flare) before the rotation begins

expectations: Output is a Seedance 2.0 (Higgsfield) prompt built around a product reveal followed by rotation showing the bottle from multiple/all angles
